summary: Most of the Round 2 fixes landed correctly. The AD memo now cleanly distinguishes `E_R(N)` from `E_R(J_N)`, the file headers/changelogs for the touched docs are aligned, the §3.3 downgrade to `[CONJ]` is an honest Choi-vs-channel demotion, the PHASE_STATUS §5.2 dependency chain is now stated in the right order, no new silent upgrade is apparent, and the tele-covariant channel chain (dephasing/depolarizing/erasure) remains preserved at channel level in `upper_bound_report §11`. I am not passing the round because there is still minor methodological residue: the new §3.1 framing in the session summary misstates the R0.2 upgrade path and is internally inconsistent, the `r_max_channel_sdp`/`log_negativity_channel_sdp` caveat is improved but not fully accurate at the API level, and a few stale cross-file references were not synchronized.

issues.description: The §3.1 rewrite removes the misleading `[THM]` heading, but the new explanatory text introduces a methodology inconsistency. It says project-level `[THM]` promotion requires C1(a) or C1(b), excluding valid C1(c), even though the project rules allow any of C1(a)/(b)/(c). In the same block it also reads as if all three listed items already satisfy the C1 numerical condition, while the status table later still marks AD Q as C1-pending.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite §3.1 to match the repository rule exactly: upgrades require `C1(a|b|c) ∧ C2 ∧ C3`, and qualify each listed item individually instead of stating a shared C1 status for all three.

issues.description: The new caveat on `log_negativity_channel_sdp` is much better, but the docstring/API still overcompresses Choi-state log-negativity into channel `R_max`: it says substituting `E_N` gives a valid strong-converse upper bound and returns that value as `R_max_bits` via the `r_max_channel_sdp` alias. For non-tele-covariant channels, this function still does not compute the channel max-Rains quantity itself.
issues.suggestion: Keep the Choi-vs-channel warning, but explicitly scope `E_N ≥ R_max` to the state-level comparison and mark `R_max_bits` / `r_max_channel_sdp` as backward-compat aliases for a Choi-state proxy, not the validated channel `R_max`.

issues.description: The version headers are fixed, but the audit trail is not fully synchronized. `PHASE_STATUS` still points the upgrade queue at `upper_bound_report v0.5`, and `PHASE1_REPORT` still describes the report as `v0.5` and keeps the old implementation-first AD `γ>1/2` queue wording instead of the new tool-selection/PDF-validation-first dependency chain.
issues.suggestion: Do one last consistency sweep over summary/queue docs so all references use `upper_bound_report v0.7` and the AD next-step wording matches the new PHASE_STATUS dependency chain.

round_recommendation: Tighten the new §3.1 wording in the session summary, make the `r_max_channel_sdp` caveat fully honest at the API/return-value level, and clean the remaining stale cross-file references. After that, this should be ready for PASS.
